component_policy.explicit_session_series: no separate series field is present in the released far-field session, waveform, or TextGrid identities; room and recording-group identities are diversity axes and are not inferred as session-series links
component_policy.known_speaker_identity: connect every session sharing an official SPK identity
component_policy.scored_exposure: intersection of the TextGrid timeline and validated waveform duration
component_policy.selection_eligibility: exclude every whole component containing a session whose forced alignment extends beyond the waveform or whose annotation-only tail exceeds the documented rule

textgrid_tail_rule.action: clip only when the forced alignment ends within the waveform; otherwise exclude the whole component

published_inventory_discrepancy.policy: use the exact shared 209-session intersection of the official far-field archive and pinned reference; do not invent or infer three absent sessions

selection_model_inputs.scored_samples: TextGrid timeline intersected with validated waveform duration

selection_policy.selection_hash_use: integrity receipt for the unique selected component list

room_workbook.selection_identity_use: binds the official room-configuration artifact; discrete room identity is the released session R field
